Perfect-hash blacklist for tip payment, config, and tip account pubkeys.

# Purpose
This header defines a perfect-hash blacklist for Solana tip payment program accounts used by `fd_pack`. It lists the mainnet and testnet tip program IDs, config accounts, and tip accounts, then builds a lookup table with `fd_map_perfect.c` so account checks can run with fixed-time access. The function [`fd_pack_tip_prog_check_blacklist`](<#fd_pack_tip_prog_check_blacklist>) returns a small status code that tells whether an account is allowed, blocked only for non-bundle transactions, or blocked for both bundle and non-bundle transactions. The comments in the file explain that the blacklist is split to stop tip theft in bundles and to reduce contention for non-bundle traffic.
